svg.text: F0_ROOT_BACK / revY_nut_passage / mm / THREE-VIEW REVIEW — NOT SHOP RELEASED
Material/process: 6061-T6 aluminium; CNC mill/turn; finished-interface drawings plus actual STEP; no blanket printed replacement
World coordinate model: sectors0/120/240deg. F1/F2 rotate F0 120/240deg; do not remachine world-angle datums.
Unspecified CNC linear +-0.10mm, drilled clearance +-0.05mm, hole position +-0.05mm DESIGN REQUIREMENTS; inspection mandatory.
Thread faces in STEP use MAJOR envelopes, NOT tap-drill sizes; M2cut drill1.6, M3cut drill2.5, inspect6H after deburr.
CAD omits thread helices. Use actual supplied screw standard; do not substitute larger ISO10642 heads forDIN7991.
M3clearance3.4 atY+-16/Z5; root foot M3x12/nuts before drive/dock
docking pad width20, M2atX53/Y+-8; actual1mm edge ligament
unbonded slip laminate mechanically captured at both ends; NO adhesive strength assumption
BRep STEP is authority for curved/hidden surfaces; this all-edge view is not a complete fabrication approval.
Supplier bend-radius/terminal-length disposition and independent drawing review remain OPEN.
